name: Jianyu
source:
Having a reputation as a just and kind ruler, king Jianyu was once quite the risk-taking, adventure-loving young royal. Now, though, he's just content to sit back and enjoy the profits of the kingdom he built with his sweat, blood, and tears.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=37940]official thread[/url]]
